title: Research
text:
Research Assistance
Graduate Research Assistant, Department of Political Science, Florida State University, 2023–present.

Build original cross-national news media corpora using Factiva, Nexis Uni, and direct publication archives, structured for quantitative text analysis, and assess outlet representation and political bias across the resulting samples.
Conduct quantitative analysis, construct and manage original datasets, and carry out systematic literature reviews for faculty research projects.
Design and document data-collection workflows for methods sections and replication materials, and develop procedural guides for incoming research assistants.

title: Research
text:
Research Skills
Quantitative methods and statistical analysis in R, construction of original cross-national media corpora, survey design in Qualtrics, and reproducible data-collection and documentation procedures. Additional software: Python and LaTeX.

title: Rachel Canino
text:
I am a Ph.D. candidate in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University, specializing in international relations and comparative politics. My research interests fall within the areas of political economy, conflict, and political psychology.
Before starting at FSU, I earned my B.A. in Political Science from Queens College, CUNY.
